data_gaps: The cause of a failed feature_valid subpixel is not stored and is not inferred.
2026 is an inference reserve. It has no thermal or feature row.
Scaler z-scores and log1p precipitation are not the physical EDA units.
2025 is described here, so this pass is not untouched holdout evidence.
1 eligible cells fall outside the inside-AOI lattice.

rules.blocks: 1 km blocks are groups of 100 canonical cells. Statistics use eligible 100 m cells only.
rules.evaluation_limit: 100 m LST describes the 1000-to-100 m learning problem. It does not validate a 10 m prediction.
rules.feature_values: Mean of the 100 valid 10 m pixels in an eligible cell, in the published physical unit. Precipitation stays in mm. Shadows are the fraction of shadowed subpixels. These are not scaler outputs.
rules.hot_cold: A cell is hot at or above the scene q90, and cold at or below the scene q10.
rules.neighbor: 4-neighborhood in the same scene. Both cells are eligible. A missing neighbor is omitted.
rules.vintage: 2017-2020 use 2020, 2021-2023 use the same year, 2024-2025 use 2024. 2026 is unassigned.
rules.weights: observation_area weights each scene-cell by class area. cell_area keeps one mean scene-anomaly per cell.

scaler_transform_policy: zscore: continuous channels; log1p+zscore: tp_0_24h/tp_24_48h/tp_48_72h; identity: shadow_building/shadow_vegetation
